question: Which of the following dances is NOT a part of the Odia culture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Kathakali**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance form from Kerala, not Odisha.
 
• **Gotipua** is a traditional dance of Odisha, performed by young boys dressed as female dancers.
 
• **Paika** is a martial dance form from Odisha, showcasing the valor and fighting spirit of the Paikas (warriors).
 
• **Dalkhai** is a folk dance from Odisha, performed during the Dussehra festival by the tribal communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odia culture** is rich in various traditional and folk dance forms.
 
• Odisha is known for its classical dance form **Odissi**, which is one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• Other notable dance forms of Odisha include **Chhau** and **Ghumura**.
 
• **Kathakali**, being a classical dance form from Kerala, emphasizes elaborate costumes, makeup, and facial expressions to depict stories from Indian epics and mythology.
